amendment: v2 adds the eight pre-registered extension firms (protocol §10 extension rule, triggered because only two core firms had >=5 anchors). Extension firms are a separate stratum and are never pooled with the core five in the headline numbers.
rule_summary: A regulatory record is attributed to a firm only if the applicant's normalised token sequence carries the firm's brand token (word-token equality, never a bare substring), which captures the firm and its divisions, subsidiaries and joint ventures. Non-brand acquired entities are NOT attributed, because attribution would require an acquisition close date that is not present in the store; they are counted as an explicit coverage loss instead of being guessed. No record is attributed by today's corporate ownership (no back-projection).
why_not_substring: substring matching would attribute 'Melmedtronics, Inc.' to Medtronic; token equality does not.

medtronic.segment_notes: all Medtronic-named divisions, subsidiaries and JVs (Sofamor Danek, MiniMed, CryoCath, ATS Medical, Xomed, Navigation, Tyrx, Advanced Energy, CoreValve, Physio-Control, Perfusion, Heart Valves, ...), and records whose applicant string carries a former legal name in parentheses after a Medtronic brand.

ge_healthcare.matched_by: GE followed by HEALTHCARE|MEDICAL|OEC|HUALUN|HANGWEI|OHMEDA, or the phrase GENERAL ELECTRIC|GENERAL ELECTRICAL
ge_healthcare.segment_notes: GE's healthcare division before the 2023-01-04 spin-off and GE HealthCare Technologies after it are the same lineage; the lineage record carries division_until=2023-01-04.

philips.segment_notes: Philips Medical Systems, Ultrasound, Medizin Systeme, Healthcare Suzhou, Image Guided Therapy, and Volcano/Invivo/Spectranetics/Respironics only when the applicant string itself carries the Philips brand. Known non-medical brand strings (Philips Lighting, Philips Consumer Lifestyle/Electronics, Philips Oral Healthcare, Philips Hearing Instruments) are retained by the frozen rule and flagged in the audit.

draeger.segment_notes: includes 'Drager Safety' (the non-medical division of the same group) and National Draeger; retained by the frozen rule and flagged in the audit.

mindray.segment_notes: Shenzhen Mindray, Mindray DS USA (the former Datascope patient-monitoring business, acquired 2008), Mindray North America.

abbott.segment_notes: Abbott Laboratories, Abbott Vascular, Abbott Medical Optics, Abbott Diabetes Care, Abbott Point of Care, St. Jude Medical only where the applicant string itself carries the Abbott brand.

baxter.segment_notes: Baxter Healthcare, Baxter International, Baxter BioScience, Gambro only where the applicant string carries the Baxter brand.

bd.segment_notes: Becton Dickinson, BD, CR Bard only where the applicant string carries a Becton/Dickinson/BD brand. The bare two-letter token BD is accepted because it is the firm's own registered short name in the FDA applicant field; the audit reports how many anchors it carries.

boston_scientific.segment_notes: Boston Scientific and its Guidant/AngioDynamics-branded submissions only where the applicant string carries the Boston Scientific brand.

edwards_lifesciences.segment_notes: Edwards Lifesciences, Edwards Laboratories, and its subsidiaries only where the applicant string carries the Edwards brand.

stryker.segment_notes: Stryker, Stryker Instruments, Stryker Spine, Stryker Endoscopy, Howmedica only where the applicant string carries the Stryker brand.

siemens_healthineers.segment_notes: Siemens Medical Solutions, Siemens Healthcare, Siemens Healthineers, and Siemens-named national sales entities. Non-medical Siemens entities are retained by the token rule and flagged in the audit if they appear.

zimmer_biomet.segment_notes: Zimmer, Zimmer Biomet and Zimmer-named subsidiaries only. BIOMET is deliberately NOT a brand token: pre-merger Biomet submissions belong to an independent company, and the store carries no acquisition close date, so including them would be exactly the back-projection this study forbids. Biomet-branded rows are counted as a coverage loss instead. 'Zimmer Medizinsysteme GmbH' is an independent German physical-therapy manufacturer and is excluded explicitly (found by independent verification: three anchors had been misattributed).

token_rule_note: boston_scientific requires BOSTON together with SCIENTIFIC; ge_healthcare requires GE together with a qualifier token or the GENERAL ELECTRIC phrase. All other firms match on their single brand token.

ge_healthcare: Wipro standalone (only the joint venture 'Wipro GE Healthcare' is included)
philips: Spectranetics Corporation (pre-2017 applicant string carries no Philips brand)
mindray: Datascope (pre-2008 applicant string carries no Mindray brand)

unknown_policy: Applicants outside every brand rule stay UNKNOWN. They are never imputed, never dropped silently, and their count is reported.
